body:
> not necessarily part of the API, but it would be good if we saved the "default state" of a widget as undefined, which won't get serialised by qs, as well as making page 1-indexed (rather than 0-indexed). That way ?p=2 will behave like you'd expect and will only get added once you go to the next page

That's part of the plan. You can see that implemented [here](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/3cb8b1f96ba2f077789ddbd2f9b28e0c8fe282ea/src/connectors/refinement-list/connectRefinementList.js#L415). However I'm not sure for the page because it introduce a shift of value and it's [pretty easy to implement](http://nebulous-balls.surge.sh/?page=3).
